findings.summary: Delivered-but-unlanded dependencies are now held. On a board directory not laid out as <root>/.ai-sdlc/dispatch (repoRootOfBoard undefined), a dependency with a success verdict lacking `landed` holds indefinitely until the landed stamp is patched. Intended and documented, but depends on the landing step always running patchDoneVerdict. A short docs note on what stamps `landed` would help debug a stuck hold.
